title: Drifting Dragons
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where dragons fly the skies like whales, the airship Quin Zaza is one of the last dragon-hunting ('draking') vessels. Its crew, including the skilled, reckless gourmet Mika and rookie Takita, hunt dragons for meat and materials, cook what they catch, and cope with repairs, money troubles and social isolation. Ostracized on the ground, the drakers depend on each other as a family.
life_message: Hard, dangerous work shared with a loyal crew, and respect for what you hunt and eat, make a meaningful life.
